Connect ERPNext to iPay. Pay with iPay on a Purchase Invoice asks iPay to pay it and opens iPay's confirmation page, where the payer enters their iPay password, the company finance PIN and an emailed code. iPay moves the money; ERPNext records the Payment Entry when iPay tells it to, in a signed and encrypted call.
1. iPay registers an API client for each Company as an ERP plugin and gives you its client id, client secret and five keys (shown once).
2. Add a row per Company below and paste them in. Frappe encrypts them; nothing is kept in code or in this public repository.
3. Give iPay this site's callback address: https://your-site/ipay/plugin, and the server's outgoing IP address.
4. Give the people who may pay the role iPay Payer. Save, then use Test Connection.
Leave Payment Account empty — it fills itself on Save.
Questions? support@doftwerks.com.
